'''Protobranch''' was a terrestrial celestial body<ref name="Insider144" /> located in the [[Protobranch system/Legends|Protobranch system]] of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Bivall/Legends|Bivall]] [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Sionver Boll/Legends|Sionver Boll]].<ref name="FF2014">{{FactFile2014|7|BOL 1-2|Sionver Boll}}</ref>

At some point by [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="HondoDate">{{HondoOhnakaScoreDate}}</ref> the Bivall [[Usk Haffa]] was the largest owner of commercial real estate on Protobranch, a fact that he proudly proclaimed to a group of other first-class passengers during a luxury cruise aboard the [[C-One liner|liner]] ''[[Salin Mariner]]''.<ref name="Insider144" />

==Behind the scenes==
Protobranch was first mentioned in [[Jason Fry]]'s short story "[[Hondo Ohnaka's Not-So-Big Score]]," which was published in the [[Star Wars Insider 144|144th issue]] of the ''[[Star Wars Insider]]'' magazine<ref name="Insider144" /> on [[September 3]], [[2013]].<ref name="Insider144Date">[[Star Wars Insider 143|''Star Wars Insider'' 143]]</ref> The [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Protobranch [[Star system/Legends|system]], and thereby Protobranch itself, in grid square J-13.<ref name="EAOC" />
